chunks: If you ask them who created them, they will answer: 'God.' How then can they turn away?
ai.seo_question: Why do polytheists acknowledge God as Creator yet worship others?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the intellectual inconsistency of the mushrikun, who acknowledge Allah’s creative power yet divert (yu'fakun) from it due to stubbornness and worldly desires. It serves as a foundational argument for tawhid, illustrating that mere verbal acknowledgment of creation is insufficient without sincere submission. The term 'yu'fakun' implies a turning away from the truth despite knowing it, a concept often linked to the role of the Imams in guiding believers beyond superficial recognition to deep spiritual insight.
